args.message: The doors slam open before you touch them. Green lightning arcs across the vast circular chamber. On a throne of twisted black iron, a figure in ornate dark armor sits with terrible stillness. The Crown of Fractures burns on his brow, its green light illuminating a face that was once noble, now hollowed by power and madness. Lord Castellan Morvain, the Dark Sovereign, rises slowly from his throne. "Ah. You've come at last. I wondered how long it would take."

lore: The Crown of Fractures pulses with a heartbeat that isn't its own. Looking at it directly makes your vision swim. It whispers promises in a language you almost understand.

greeting: Ah. You've come at last. I wondered how long it would take.

combat: THE CROWN IS MINE! THE REALM IS MINE! ALL OF IT!
I was a SERVANT! A castellan! Now I am a SOVEREIGN!
You cannot kill what the Crown sustains!
Torven was a fool! A useful fool, but a fool! I am what he could NEVER be!
KNEEL! Kneel before the true ruler of these shattered lands!
Do you feel it? The Crown's power? It could be yours too. Just... stop... fighting...
lore: I found it in the deepest vault. The king's ancestors had sealed it there. They were wise to fear it.
But they were also weak. The Crown doesn't corrupt — it reveals. It shows you what you truly are.
Aldric was a good king. But even good kings die. The Crown... the Crown endures.

greeting: You survived the Glass Fields. That earns you water and shade.
The Sandwalkers welcome those the desert does not swallow.
quest: Emberlord Azrak guards the eastern approach to the citadel.
He was not always a monster. Once, he was a guardian spirit of the earth.
The Crown corrupted him. Turned the guardian into a weapon.
To reach the citadel from here, you must go through him. There is no other path.
But I know his weakness. The obsidian platform he stands on — it channels the Crown's power to him.
Destroy the platform's anchor stones first. Without them, he is just fire. Still dangerous, but mortal.
lore: This was grassland once. My grandmother remembers green fields, cattle, rain.
The heat came in a single day. A wave of fire from the citadel. Everything burned.
We adapted. The Sandwalkers always adapt. But this... this we cannot outlast.
The standing stones at this oasis are older than the kingdom. They protect us. Without them, even this water would boil.
trade: Desert spices, waterskins, and fire resistance salve. You'll want all three.
farewell: May the wind be at your back and the sand beneath your feet be cool.
If you kill the Emberlord... come back. I want to see green again.

You feel the blight's presence recede from your mind like a tide pulling back. A translucent figure materializes at the altar. A king, long dead, with kind sad eyes.

greeting: At last... someone with the strength to listen.
I am — was — Aldric. Third of my name. This was my castle. My kingdom.
quest: The Crown of Fractures cannot be destroyed by sword or spell alone.
It must be removed from Morvain's brow while he lives. Only then, when it has no host...
Strike it against the throne. The throne is bonded to the bloodline. My bloodline.
The impact will shatter the Crown. And the blight... will end.
But Morvain will fight to keep it. The Crown won't let him surrender.
You must weaken him until the Crown's grip falters. Look for the moment of doubt in his eyes.
lore: My ancestors sealed the Crown in the deepest vault for good reason.
It is not evil. Not exactly. It is a mirror that shows you the worst version of yourself — and makes it real.
Morvain was my most trusted advisor. Loyal, brilliant, dedicated.
The Crown showed him a version of himself with power. With control. With everything he secretly wanted.
He couldn't resist. Nobody can, not for long. That's why it must be broken.
When the Crown breaks, the blight will recede. The dead will rest. The ice will thaw.
And Morvain... Morvain will remember what he was. That may be the cruelest part.
farewell: I cannot leave this chapel. The wards hold me here as much as they protect you.
End this. Not for me — for him. For everyone the Crown has consumed.

zones.description: The main gate hangs open — not from damage, but as invitation. The Dark Sovereign wants you to enter. The iron portcullis has been twisted into a grinning face.

greeting: Don't — don't attack! I'm not with them anymore!
Thank the gods, living people. Real, breathing, living people.
quest: I was guild muscle. Torven's men. We brought supplies to the citadel for months.

The main hall is patrolled by fallen knights. They never stop. Never rest.
But the side corridor — the trapped corridor — it's dangerous, but the traps are mechanical. Avoidable.
Past that, there's a war chapel. The old wards still hold there. You can rest safely.
The throne room is beyond the chapel. That's where Morvain waits. With the Crown.
One more thing. The Crown — I don't think destroying Morvain is enough. You have to break the Crown itself.
lore: Torven — that's the guild master — he's been feeding resources to Morvain. Money, soldiers, materials.
Nobody knows why. Fear, probably. Or promises. The Crown can show you things. Things you want to see.
There were others like me. Soldiers who realized what we were part of. Most didn't make it out.
The fallen knights? They were Ashenmere's royal guard. Good men. The Crown took them.
Morvain talks to the Crown. I've heard him. Late at night, whispering to it like it's alive.
Maybe it is.
farewell: I'm going south. Far south. Don't follow me.
Good luck. You'll need it. And... I'm sorry. For my part in this.

lore_1.text: Then that fool Morvain found the artifact. Or it found him. Hard to say which.

options.text: Tell me more about the blight.

lore_2.text: The blight started slow. Bad harvests. Animals going wrong. Then the land itself started changing.

lore_3.text: We get refugees from every direction now. Each one tells a worse story than the last.

lore_4.text: There's a man in the citadel at the center of it all. Calls himself the Dark Sovereign.

lore_5.text: Torven — that's the guild master — he's been funneling resources to Morvain for months. Nobody knows why.

options.text: Sounds like we need to pay him a visit.

quest_0.text: You look like the fighting type. Good. We need that.

quest_1.text: Three roads lead out of Millhaven. North into the forest, east to the swamp, and west up the pass.

options.text: Any advice before we head out?

quest_2.text: Nobody's come back from the north in weeks. Whatever's up there, it's getting worse.

options.text: Any advice before we head out?

quest_3.text: If you're heading out, talk to Durin about gear. And say a prayer at Sister Maren's chapel. Can't hurt.

quest_brave.text: Ale's warm, stew's hot, and the roof doesn't leak. Much. You'll need a proper send-off.

hub.text: What else do you want to know?

options.text: We helped some refugees on the road.

se_refugees.text: Word travels fast. I heard you helped some refugees on the road. That kind of decency is rare these days. Drinks are on me tonight.

options.text: It was the right thing to do.

farewell_0.text: Don't die out there. I hate wasting good ale on memorials.

greeting: Oh thank the stone! I've been trapped here for... days? Weeks? Time's strange underground.
Mind the rocks, the whole section's unstable.
quest: The forge! The old dwarven forge is deeper in. I was looking for it when the cave-in hit.
There are things guarding it now. Golems, but wrong. The crystals grew through them.
Past the gallery, keep left. The forge is behind a door with a hammer sigil.
The star-iron's in there — I'm sure of it. My grandfather told me about this place.
lore: The crystals weren't always this color. They used to be blue. Clear. Beautiful.
Then that green started creeping in. The hum changed. Lower. Angrier.
There's a chamber at the very bottom with a crystal the size of a house. Pulsing. Like a heart.
I think it's connected to whatever's happening up top. A relay, channeling power from the center.
If you could destroy that crystal... might weaken the corruption for miles around.
farewell: I'll wait here. Not going deeper without an army. Or at least a stiff drink.
If you find the forge, bring me back a souvenir. Preferably not cursed.

greeting: Eh? More strangers. Town's full of 'em these days.
You've got that look. The hero look. I've seen it before.
lore: I remember when you could walk to the citadel in a day. Pleasant road, wildflowers.
Morvain wasn't always mad, you know. He was the king's castellan. Good man. Then he found that crown.
First sign was the animals. Wolves with bark growing through their fur. Spiders big as dogs.
The Crossing used to be a bridge over the Ashwater. Now the whole riverbed is black.
There's a hermit up on the mountain pass. Harlen. He was the king's cartographer. Might still have maps.
If you're going to the citadel, go through the Crossing. It's the only direct route. Everything else is a longer way around.
farewell: I'll be here. Not like I've got anywhere else to go.

quests.name: The Spiral's Secret
quests.description: Harlen believes the blight follows ancient ley lines. Check the standing stone at the summit to confirm his theory.
objectives: Return to Harlen with your findings

quests.name: Clear Skies
quests.description: Skarn the Windcaller and her harpy flock have made the pass nearly impassable. Clear the nests to reopen the route.

quests.name: Roots of Corruption
quests.description: Rotfather Vael, the corrupted guardian of the Ashwater, blocks the direct path to the Obsidian Citadel. His roots spread the blight to surrounding biomes. Destroying him won't stop the corruption, but it will slow its spread and open the way forward.
objectives: Open the path to the Obsidian Citadel

quests.name: The Frozen Heart
quests.description: Sigrid believes a frost wyrm bound beneath the frozen lake is the source of the unnatural winter. She'll fight alongside you to end it — and to give her fallen warriors rest.
objectives: Clear the Ice Wraiths in Wraith Hollow
Reach the Frozen Lake with Sigrid

quests.name: The Herbalist's Request
quests.description: Elara needs three Moonpetal Blossoms from the spider nests to brew a potion of blight resistance.
objectives: Collect 3 Moonpetal Blossoms from Spider Hollow
Return to Elara in the Druid's Clearing

quests.name: Thin the Pack
quests.description: The blighted wolves have made their den too close to the path. Clear them out to secure the route deeper into the forest.
objectives: Defeat the Blighted Wolves in the Wolf Den

quests.name: Shatter the Crown
quests.description: King Aldric's ghost reveals the Crown of Fractures can only be destroyed by removing it from Morvain and striking it against the bonded throne. Defeat the Dark Sovereign, seize the Crown, and end the blight forever.
objectives: Strike the Crown against the throne to shatter it

quests.name: Dethrone the Emberlord
quests.description: Emberlord Azrak blocks the eastern approach to the Obsidian Citadel. Zahara knows his weakness — destroy the anchor stones on his platform to sever his connection to the Crown before engaging him.
objectives: Destroy the anchor stones (optional — weakens Azrak)

quests.name: The Lost Patrol
quests.description: Captain Thessa's patrol went into the Sunken Swamp three days ago and hasn't returned. Find the soldiers or recover their insignias.
objectives: Find the lost patrol or their insignias

quests.name: The Old Forge
quests.description: Durin needs star-iron from an ancient dwarven forge in the Crystal Caves. With it, he can craft weapons capable of cutting through the blight's corruption.
objectives: Find the ancient forge in the Crystal Caves

quests.name: Fading Wards
quests.description: The protective wards on Millhaven's chapel are failing. Sister Maren needs dawn lotus flowers from the Frozen Wastes to restore them and bless the party's weapons against the blight.
objectives: Return to Sister Maren at the Chapel

quests.name: Quiet the Dead
quests.description: Nessa can brew a tincture to pacify the restless dead, but she needs the skull from whatever ancient creature lies beneath the Bone Mound.
objectives: Defeat the Swamp Lurkers guarding the Bone Mound

quests.name: Shatter the Relay
quests.description: Brokk believes the massive crystal at the deepest point of the caves is a relay channeling the Crown's power. Destroy it to weaken the blight across the eastern realms.
